title: SD PUC Order — Docket EL26-003: In the Matter of the Application of Black Hills Power, Inc. dba Black Hills Energy for Authority to Increase Rates For its Utility Service in South Dakota (Order Granting Motion to Amend Procedural Schedule)

EL26-003 
On February 19, 2026, the South Dakota Public Utilities Commission (Commission) 
received an application by Black Hills Power, Inc. dba Black Hills Energy (BHP) for approval to 
increase rates for electric service to customers in its South Dakota service territory by 
approximately $50.6 million annually or approximately 25.1 % based on BHP's test year ending 
September 30, 2025. The Company states a typical residential electric customer using 650 kWh 
per month would see an increase of $25.13 per month. The proposed changes may potentially 
affect approximately 75,000 customers in BHP's South Dakota service territory. 
On February 26, 2026, the Commission electronically transmitted notice of the filing and 
the intervention deadline of April 17, 2026, to interested individuals and entities on the 
Commission's PUC Weekly Filing electronic listserv. On April 8, 2026, the Commission granted 
intervention to John D. McKee Sr. On May 13, 2026, the Commission granted intervention to 
Dakota Panel, Fischer Furniture, Inc., Forest Products Distributors, Inc., GCC Dacotah, Inc., 
Monument Health Rapid City Hospital, Inc., Pete Lien & Sons, Inc., the South Dakota Science 
and Technology Authority, and Spearfish Forest Products Inc (South Dakota Large Customer 
Group). On May 21, 2026, the Commission issued an Order Granting Motion for Approval of 
Procedural Schedule. On June 8, 2026, Intervenor John D. McKee Sr. (Mr. McKee) filed a Motion 
to Adopt Protective Order. On June 16, 2026, BHP filed a Letter regarding Response to McKee's 
Motion to Adopt Protective Order and on June 17, 2026, Mr. McKee filed a Reply. On June 22, 
2026, Staff filed a Motion to Amend Procedural Schedule. 
The Commission has jurisdiction in this matter pursuant to SDCL Chapters 1-26 and 49-
34A. 
At its regularly scheduled meeting on June 30, 2026, the Commission considered this 
matter. Staff requested the Commission grant the Motion to Amend Procedural Schedule. Neither 
BHP, Mr. McKee, nor South Dakota Large Customer Group objected to the Staffs Motion. The 
Commission voted unanimously to grant the Motion to Amend Procedural Schedule filed on June 
22, 2026. Commissioner Hanson made a motion to Issue Protective Order to adopt the BHP 
Agreement and deny Mr. McKee's request for Protective Order. Commissioner Nelson moved to 
amend the motion requiring BHP to craft language regarding the allowance of closed loop Al. The 
Commission voted 1-2, Commissioners Fiegen and Hanson dissenting, on Commissioner 
Nelson's motion. Commissioner Hanson moved to defer his original motion to the next meeting. 
It is therefore 
ORDERED, that the Motion to Amend Procedural Schedule is granted. It is further 
ORDERED, that the procedural schedule is Amended as follows: 

Evidentiary Hearing ............................... , .... .December 7-9, 2026 
It is further 
ORDERED, that responses to discovery are due -ten business days after service of 
discovery unless a different period is agreed upon by the requesting Party and responding 
Party. It is further 
ORDERED, that further consideration of a protective order is deferred to the July 14, 
2026, Commission meeting.
